thread:
kevin: Heads-up: helix-small q5_dynamic quant bring-up failing multilang sanity. Chinese sentence with inline Hebrew in fullwidth parens is coming out with reversed Hebrew letters and the parentheses relocating. Repro below.
riko: Can you paste the exact input + command?
kevin: sure. Ran local suite on CPU fallback (x86). Command:
```
./tools/run_eval --model=models/helix-small:q5-latest --suite=multilang_regression --inputs=testcases/cn_he_mixed.json --threads=1
```
Input example:
```
今天去公园（שלום 12）很开心。
```
Observed output:
```
（םולש 21）今天去公园很开心。
```
Notes: Hebrew letters look reversed and digits swapped, paren moved to before Hebrew span.
sofia: BLEU on the small smoke: fp16 baseline 31.1 -> helix-q5 22.4. chrF -6.0. Token mismatch +37/150, mostly when hebrew/arabic script is inside CJK punctuation.
riko: Is this only q5 or other quant levels? kevin: quick checks: q8 dynamic = fine. q4 has tiny artefacts. q5 strong. Also only reproducible when runtime fallback=cpu_compat; GPU path looks OK.
eval-bot: Auto-ticket: failure=ml-reg-3141593000-e; model_sha=7f9b2d; repo=infra/models/helix-small; kernel=cpu_compat_v1
kevin: run config snippet:
```
quant:
  scheme: q5_dynamic
  per_channel: false
runtime:
  fallback: cpu_compat_v1
tokenizer:
  detok: icu-detok-v1
```
sofia: icu-detok-v1 is our older detok; we shipped icu-detok-v2 to the non-quant packing which preserves BIDI marks when merging short spans. Might be related.
riko: I'll try swapping detok to icu-detok-v2 on the q5 build and re-run the suite. If that fixes it we either (A) change the packed detok used by quant builds, or (B) patch cpu_compat_v1 detok behavior.
kevin: logs uploaded: s3://redwood-triage/3141593000/helix-q5-logs.tar.gz
deploy-bot: Canary hold: helix-small-q5 auto-promote disabled in eu-west-1 until triage completes. Reason: locale tokenization regression.
riko: quick grep in packer output shows the token-packer replaces ZWJ with zero-width-space in q5 artifacts under certain size thresholds. That could change how the detok sees script boundaries.
sofia: if packer is dropping BIDI control characters or swapping ZWJ/ZWNJ we will lose mirror flags and detok will produce wrong ordering during concat. Could also be that the q5 packer reorders tokens when compressing short spans.
kevin: mitigation: pin helix-small fp16 for EU CN-Hebrew routes and add a rule to routing policy to prefer non-quant variant for multiorient locales.
riko: triage plan: (1) run q5 with icu-detok-v2; (2) run q5 artifact through token-unpack tool and diff codepoints vs fp16 artifact; (3) if mismatch, bisect packer commits; (4) add unit tests.
sofia: please add a focused test to the multilang_regression suite checking bracket attachment and numeric orientation for CJK<>RTL mixes. CI gate for quant builds.
kevin: created ticket RI-1501 with links and added failing sample id cnhe-3141593000 to tests/anchors.json
riko: will update this thread with bisect results, aiming EOD CET.
sofia: thanks! also can we add a small fuzz corpus for short mixed spans? that caught similar issues before.
kevin: done, added 50 synthetic short-span samples under tests/fuzz/cn_rtl_short.json
deploy-bot: rollback condition: >3 user errors/min OR BLEU drop >5 on canary -> auto-route to helix-small-fp16.
kevin: marking this monitored; will reopen if regressions persist. reactions: :rotating_light: :wrench:
riko: ping me if you want help on the packer bisect, I can instrument the token-unpack traces.
sofia: I'll own the multilang_regression test PR. Appreciate the quick triage team.
